messages:
sara kim: quick note — brought atlas-lite v1 (q5) to canary for multilingual regression suite. small overall delta but flagged locale-specific regressions for CJK vertical text and hebrew digit ordering. eval-bot: artifact s3://redwood-evals/atlas-lite/v1/q5/multilang/report.html
yuki tanaka: can you paste a minimal repro for the hebrew numeral issue?
sara kim: sure. ref vs hyp below, digits appear reversed in hyp
```
ref: כפר 2026-03-21 08:41 123
hyp: כרפ 321 08:41
```
omar haddad: ran local smoke: `./eval --model atlas-lite --quant q5 --suites multilingual/quick` -> heb-digit-mirror 9/64, tib-dev attach 5/40, overall BLEU -0.9
yuki tanaka: tokenizer commit f1e2d3 changed script-run boundaries; runtime commit a9b8c7 modified pack order. I'll bisect tokenizer first (fast).
sara kim: quick mitigation: run detokenize with `--preserve-numeric-order` in postproc; reduces heb failures to 1/64. Not a long-term fix but useful to keep canary green.
eval-bot: added failing pairs to RED-3410. metrics attached.
yuki tanaka: starting tokenizer bisect now. omar, can you run runtime kernel bisect in parallel?
omar haddad: on it. will report earliest bad rev.
sara kim: adding small CI smoke tests for heb-digit and tib-dev mix for quant builds. will PR today.
eval-bot: canary rolled back to q4 at 2026-03-21T11:21Z due to regression alert.
